description: This file defines the IBasketViewModelService interface, which provides methods for retrieving, creating, and mapping basket view models in the eShopWeb application. It serves as an interface to encapsulate basket-related operations for the web layer.

classes.name: IBasketViewModelService
classes.description: Interface defining basket view model operations, including retrieving, creating, and mapping baskets for users.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an existing basket or creates a new one for the specified user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in the user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Converts a Basket domain entity into a BasketViewModel.
